request.description: Compiles the draft (resolving every question into a frozen snapshot), refuses it if there are problems or nothing changed since the last published version, and opens a change request with a diff for a checker. Publishes `config.change_requested`. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).
